title: MULTITRIG: page and track-wide lock editing
author: Cere, made with Claude
description: In GRID RECORDING: hold a trig and tap PAGE (every trig on its page) or TRK (every trig on the track), then turn a knob to edit them all. SETTINGS > MULTI EDIT: REL keeps each trig's own value and moves them together (transpose a page or a track); ABS gives them all the held trig's value. Letting go clears the selection. The setting is saved.
